description: Grounded questions over the sample PDFs in data/documents/. expected_sources are filenames present in the FAISS metadata. groundedness and citation_score are left null for manual scoring.

items.question: When is a firewall useful according to the documents?
items.expected_answer: A firewall is only useful when its rules match a written policy.

items.question: What are common sources of avoidable network security risk?
items.expected_answer: Default-allow rules, unused open ports, and undocumented exceptions.

items.question: What kind of authentication methods should be preferred?
items.expected_answer: Phishing-resistant methods such as hardware keys or platform authenticators.

items.question: Why do shared passwords and long-lived tokens increase risk?
items.expected_answer: They increase blast radius when an account is stolen.

items.question: What unused remote-access items should be retired?
What does document ingestion convert files into?
Why does PDF extraction preserve source and page numbers?
items.expected_answer: So later answers can cite evidence.

items.question: Why does chunking use overlapping windows?
items.expected_answer: So a sentence that crosses a boundary is not lost.

items.question: What must metadata keep for FAISS vectors?
items.expected_answer: A one-to-one map from vector position to chunk text.

items.question: What does network security start with?
items.expected_answer: Clear ownership of assets, identities, and data flows.

items.question: What is the on-call phone number for the security operations center?
items.expected_answer: The documents do not contain this information.

items.question: Which Kubernetes CIDR does the production cluster use?
items.expected_answer: The documents do not contain this information.
